label: JOINT datatype-protection analysis: protection options none and scale_tmr (INT scale word stored 3x, majority vote), both implemented and measured; the datatype-only analysis is the p = none subset
R_scale_columns: R_scale_pooled_format_pp (used by the optimiser), R_scale_any_k1_mean_drop_pp (per layer)
Q_definition: PRIMARY Q (Q_fisher_val_exact) = sum_i F_i (w_i - w_hat_i)^2 with F = diagonal Fisher of the FP32 model, expectation over labels computed EXACTLY, on held-out validation images 0..2047; w_hat = decoded frozen Stage 2 encoding. ALTERNATIVE (Q_fisher_train_sampled): same with the sampled-label true Fisher on 1,024 training images (this network is saturated on its training images and the sampled estimator undercounts; see phase5/Q_ANALYSIS.md)
R_definition: R_exposure(l,d,p) = 8 * (n_l/N) * max(0, mean(k1 drop, k8 drop / 8)) in percentage points, Stage 4 'any bit' layer-wise drops (20 trials x 1,000 validation images each); sum over layers = predicted mean accuracy drop under 8 random flips over all stored weight bits of the assembled model. Scale-word faults are a separate metric.
notes: Layer-additive scores approximate the full model; the selected assignment must be assembled and measured end to end.
R_scale_* is a different fault process (one flipped bit of an INT scale word) and is a SECOND metric, never merged into the primary R.

Clean accuracy: format-level (Stage 2) and, per layer, the single-layer measurement clean_single_layer_* (validation images 2,048-4,999, q_layerwise_validation.csv); the complete-model clean accuracy is measured end to end.
